verdict.rationale: Pigment's MCP server documentation says agent sessions are authenticated through enterprise identity, with access scoped by role, model or metric, and that admins approve which assistants connect. That is first-party least-privilege scoping for agents. However, nothing shows that a user can issue dedicated, scoped API credentials such as keys or tokens to an agent; access appears tied to identity sessions instead. Missing for 10: documented issuance of agent-specific API keys/tokens, per-credential scope definitions, credential rotation/revocation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
